organization: Journal of Economic Literature (American Economic Association)
public_contact_or_submission: proposal sketch or full paper via ScholarOne webform; institutional contact page
why_relevant: publishes review essays such as Ravallion 2018 'Inequality and Globalization: A Review Essay'; the natural venue for a synthesis that unbundles the two conjuncts
notes: begin with a roughly ten-page proposal; full papers also accepted; data and code policy applies to empirical work; no personal email used

public_contact_or_submission: public general-comments address and contact page
why_relevant: trade and distribution is a core PIIE research area; an opt-in public comments channel exists
notes: institutional comments address only; the page states the Institute cannot respond to each query; no personal email used

field: international trade and investment, labour economics, inequality
public_contact_or_submission: public contact page with institutional functional addresses; International Trade and Investment program
why_relevant: runs an International Trade and Investment program and a Trade topic archive where distributional trade work appears
notes: use institutional functional channels (for example info@ or data@), never a named researcher's address; contact page reached via the linked /contact-nber route

field: labour economics, earnings inequality, policy evaluation
public_contact_or_submission: public contact block and open calls for papers on the network site
why_relevant: labour-market incidence is the mechanism slot of this question; the network publishes discussion papers and calls for papers
notes: network coordinated by LISER since 2026 after the Bonn institute closed; use the institutional info@ channel or the calls-for-papers route; no personal email used

field: harmonised household income data, within-country inequality
public_contact_or_submission: public data documentation and linked contact page
why_relevant: LIS is one of the three anchor datasets for within-country inequality in the world sources; a checker needs to know what this slot actually measures
notes: this is a data venue, not a submission venue for claims; the contact link on the page is /about-lis/contact/

field: development economics, poverty, the Poverty and Inequality Platform
why_relevant: publishes PIP, the main global survey-based source for both within-country and between-country inequality
notes: use general inquiries only; the contact page lists many named staff emails that are deliberately not used here; no personal email used
